translations.translatedText: # Friday 2.7.2021
Entry model. Football tourists' coronavirus infections. India's coronavirus situation. Sleeping in hot weather. The weather stays hot.
## Entry model

![Passenger arriving in Finland wearing a mask at Helsinki-Vantaa airport.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5005,h_2815,x_0,y_375/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-82792060dee7cf265cd/1625221160)
Open image viewer
You can travel to Finland from abroad again. Photo: Teemu Salonen / Lehtikuva
Finland has decided on the rules for travel.
Parliament approved Finland's entry model on Friday. The entry model sets out how people may travel to Finland from abroad during the corona times.

A traveller may come to Finland without corona tests, if they have received both coronavirus vaccinations. A traveller also does not need to go for a corona test if they have had coronavirus disease. The coronavirus disease must not have been more than 6 months ago.
In addition, all travellers can get to Finland without a corona test from countries where the corona situation is very good. Now such countries include, for example, Germany and Italy.
## Football tourists' coronavirus infections
![Football supporters.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4109,h_2311,x_0,y_212/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-81959260c475e3be056/1623488037)
Open image viewer
Photo: Tomi Hänninen
Authorities have now found the coronavirus infections that came to Finland with football tourists from St. Petersburg.
The football tourists got about 400 coronavirus infections from St. Petersburg. Because of the infections, hundreds of people have been ordered to stay at home in quarantine.
## Coronavirus infections in India

![A couple poses for a photographer after receiving the Covaxin coronavirus vaccine in Amritsar, India, on 30 May 2021.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4848,h_2727,x_272,y_152/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-81561760b9cee5286ab/1622790046)
Open image viewer
The Indian couple went for a photo after the coronavirus vaccination. Photo: Narinder Nanu / AFP
The coronavirus situation in India is bad. More than 400,000 people have already died in India because of corona.
India is the 3rd country where so many coronavirus deaths have been recorded. Over 400,000 coronavirus deaths have also been recorded in the USA and Brazil.
Experts estimate that there are really many more coronavirus deaths in India than the statistics show.
## Sleeping in hot weather
![A man looks at an alarm clock.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11202197)
Open image viewer
Many people cannot sleep if it is too hot. Photo: Thomas Baker / AOP
Finland's summer has been hot. In hot weather many people sleep badly.

Specialist doctor Anu Muraja-Murro says that heat strains the heart and circulation also at night. The heart has to pump more blood to the skin so that the body cools down. That is why sleep does not refresh as well as usual.
Muraja-Murro says that it is important to keep the bedroom cool. In the daytime the windows and curtains are closed, and the bedroom is aired only late in the evening.

In the evening it is not good to do hard exercise or eat spicy food, because they raise the body's temperature. A cool shower before going to bed can help you sleep better, says specialist doctor Anu Muraja-Murro.
## Weekend weather
![weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12007479)
Open image viewer
Photo: Yle
The weekend weather is also sunny and warm. The weather is also dry, that is, no rain falls.
Almost everywhere in the country the temperature is about 30 degrees. The weather feels very hot.
